glosses: choir (ensemble of people who sing together)
choral song (song written for a choir to perform)

examples.text: Tom canta no coral da igreja.
examples.en: Tom sings in the church choir.

examples.text: Tom canta no coral da escola.
examples.en: Tom sings in the school chorus.

examples.text: O recife de corais é a atração principal da região.
examples.en: The coral reef is the region's prime attraction.
